description: Factual, source-cited, NON-adjudicating discrepancy observation emitted by a danjo cross-reference cell over the open-government corpus (ADR-2605263900). R0 skeleton per ADR-2605301600 §3/§4; ref-typed nesting added (R1 hardening = additionalProperties:false + required-field enforcement). CONSTITUTIONAL: this record states a FACTUAL cross-reference only — it MUST NOT assert that a crime / law violation / 不正 occurred (G4 UPL-equivalent). `nonAdjudicatingNotice` is required and MUST be true; the `category` enum contains NO crime/violation/guilt value (a legal verdict is unrepresentable at the schema layer). `sourceRecordCids` MUST contain ≥2 upstream gov.dataset.* record CIDs (G5). `methodNoteCid` is required (G6 open method). Named parties (G10) are structured via #namedPartyRef: a party may be named ONLY by citing the public source record that already names them. Legal characterization routes to external counsel via chigiri + Public Fund (Council Lv6+).

sourceCellDid.description: DID of the danjo cell that computed the observation

category.description: FACTUAL cross-reference category ONLY. No crime/violation/guilt value exists (G4).

severity.description: Routing/review weight ONLY; severity is NOT a finding of wrongdoing. `elevated` gates named-party publication review (G10).

description.description: Human-readable FACTUAL statement of the cross-reference; passes PII filter (G9). MUST NOT contain legal-conclusion language.

sourceRecordCids.description: ≥2 upstream gov.dataset.* record CIDs that ground this observation (G5)

crossReferenceLinkCids.description: danjo.crossReferenceLink record CIDs supporting the observation

methodNoteCid.description: danjo.methodNote record CID defining the open, versioned detector heuristic (G6)

nonAdjudicatingNotice.description: MUST be true. Asserts this is a factual cross-reference, NOT a legal verdict (G4).

namedParties.description: Names ONLY where the source records already name the party publicly AND severity-gated + Council-reviewed (G10). Each entry MUST cite the public record that names them. Empty at R0/R1.

externalCounselReferralCid.description: If legal characterization is sought: the chigiri-routed external-counsel engagement CID. danjo itself renders NO opinion (G4).

namedPartyRef.description: A party named in an observation. STRUCTURAL G10 enforcement: a party may be named ONLY by citing the public source record that already names them, with the publication basis recorded. danjo never originates a name.

displayName.description: Name as it appears VERBATIM in the cited public source record (procurement awardee / Diet member / budget recipient).

partyLei.description: GLEIF LEI if the party is a legal entity (corp.leiReference).

partyDid.description: DID if the party is an etzhayyim member (rare; usually absent for state-side parties).

publiclyNamedBasis.description: WHY the party is already public in the source corpus. No other basis permits naming (G10).

sourceRecordCid.description: The single gov.dataset.* record CID that ALREADY names this party publicly.
